verdict.rationale: Prebuilt connectors are a fair question for a workflow automation platform like Windmill, so the axis applies. The pack, however, documents no catalog of prebuilt, vendor-maintained app integrations. It shows only multi-language scripting (developer building blocks) and event triggers such as Kafka, Postgres and SQS, which are a different capability from app connectors.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can connect to thousands of apps through prebuilt, vendor-maintained integrations
